body:
Bounded T278 prerequisite after shared authority extraction T286 at d75801d. Product direction is approved in original .adlc/specs/62-bound-renderer-activation.md. Independent P1 recommendation is /tmp/loam-t278-evidence/T278-next-context-review.md. Introduce a mandatory discriminated root/bound renderer execution context. This trusted internal library primitive is not durable activation, remote authorization, or a mounted route. Keep bound HTTP app/bytes refusal, existing operator roster, root channel routing and pen/write behavior unchanged.

Add src/gateway/renderer-context.ts exporting createRootRendererContext(gateway, door, now), where now is a required () => number and the requester is explicitly the trusted root API/public door selected by door; and createBoundRendererContext({authority, destination, binding, requester, execution, now}), all fields required. authority/execution are Gateway; destination/requester strings; binding ConnectionBinding; now () => number. Contexts distinguish explicit root law/data from destination boundSurface/connectionScope. Factories reject missing context members, mismatched destination/container and requester/key named by exact inbox. Bound context is full-door/read-only, and execution must have an explicit live PoolEnvelope: no primary fallback. These are trusted host factories, not transport-supplied callbacks or a proof of future channel activation. Eventual audience is not restricted to the activator by this primitive.

Export prepareRendererInContext(binding: RendererBinding, context: RendererContext): Promise<void> and renderRendererInContext(binding: RendererBinding, entity: string, context: RendererContext, options?: {gesture?: existing reads/state shape; asOf?: number}): Promise<existing render response> from renderers.ts. Existing prepareRouteImpl/serveRouteImpl select root or channel-pool bindings as before, then explicitly create a root context and use this common core. Do not introduce a second worker execution implementation. Context determines visible law, registry, first-paint and every mediated read, envelope and framing. Reuse bound ordinary resolution but correct its child resolver lookup in reads.ts to the bound fold rather than root registered law. Preserve root resolver lookup. No automatic resolver adoption is added.

Refuse bound pen-bearing RendererBinding, version-pinned binding and asOf options explicitly; do not silently switch to latest, present or root. Missing/invalid context cannot admit or return rendered HTML. Recheck live connection standing before admission/render, after admission awaits and after worker completion before returning bytes. Reusing a context after revocation or ancestor removal refuses while an independent connection still works. Resolve live envelope limits each call, preserving existing admission budget identity, shared slots, confined admission/render, timeout accounting and truthful V8-heap limitation. Do not claim retroactive resizing of a running worker. Byte assets, bound history/version catalog and source activation are explicitly unsupported intermediate capabilities.

Author test/gateway/renderer-context.test.ts before source, using real signed gateway/container/inbox state and real-worker positive controls. Prove same entity root/destination/sibling isolation for first paint and gesture reads; container-local law and child expansion select the bound fold; requester/destination mismatch and missing execution envelope refuse; pens, version pins and asOf refuse; reused contexts enforce revoked grant/ancestor and preserve a live bystander; after-await revocation cannot release HTML; changed live envelope applies on the next call. A deterministic await seam may be mocked only alongside real-worker success controls. Preserve all existing rails. Run new test, test/gateway/renderers.test.ts, render-gesture.test.ts, bound-fold.test.ts, render-sandbox.test.ts, render-ocap.test.ts, render-cap.test.ts, render-spawn-clock.test.ts, render-spawn-forwarding.test.ts, probation-frame.test.ts, and test/server/app-asof.test.ts plus connection-container.test.ts. Run appropriate full checks and independent reviews. Freeze authored hash before implementation; module/API-absence red is not claimed as missing historical behavior.

Do not claim full T278 completion or usable bound app serving. Later tickets must add exact source-channel identity, durable attributed activation/withdrawal, and authenticated serving/tool discovery together. No whole-T274 migration belongs here. Land or stack this bounded prerequisite without making T263 completion depend on itself.

Independent P1 clarifications settled before rail freeze: factories throw on malformed inputs. prepareRendererInContext rejects with Error("renderer context refuses this request") for invalid/nonstanding/unsupported context or bound binding. renderRendererInContext returns {status:404, contentType:"text/plain; charset=utf-8", body:"no such route"} for those cases, without worker execution; existing worker fault/timeout responses remain unchanged. Existing root route preparation still no-ops for unknown/unservable routes. Only factory-produced contexts are accepted at runtime (private WeakSet/WeakMap or equivalent opaque validation); a forged kind tag cannot select the root branch. Freeze context identity and copy/freeze binding.container and binding.inbox so later mutation of caller input cannot change authority. Gateway handles remain live. Bound law/data use authority destination scope; worker limits/slots and probation framing use execution gateway. If its envelope disappears, refuse. Execution is trusted host selection, not proved source-channel admission. Refuse bound bindings with either pen or writable defined, even malformed combinations. Any defined bound asOf refuses (including zero); never test truthiness. Call now() on each invocation for current evaluation and pass that wall-clock value through reads; nonfinite time refuses before execution. Expanded-child control distinguishes resolver selection, not only schema expansion. Cover both revoke-during-admission and revoke-during-render while retaining actual worker success. Missing/forged context is checked before accessing bundle. These clarify the approved staged boundary; no new product decision is pending.

Authored rail SHA256 f824264f6b485a48f421297d41199f9a677af3e45049d12abc14b610ae255cfd. Ten real-state controls include a signed slate deadline transition: first paint and mediated reads lose only condemned data when the context clock advances, while oak remains visible and histories stay unchanged. Module-absence red measured before source implementation. Freeze applies from the authored checkpoint, not from a changed-test repair.

Independent mutation verification found missing malformed-field and bound read-fault controls (T287-mutation-verification.json); findings recorded before fixes. Add test/gateway/renderer-context-errors.test.ts without changing the original frozen rail. Cover invalid root gateway/door, fake execution handle with real envelope, numeric or empty destination/requester and binding.container mismatch while inbox remains exact. Prove bound read faults return uniform 404 while root error behavior remains compatible, using actual worker positive controls plus deterministic failure injection. Include test/server/app-asof.test.ts in mutation verification; its existing controls already kill the history-forwarding mutant. Simplify factory validation to declared fields via optional chaining, preserving all required types/equalities/envelope/opaque issuance and frozen identity. Structurally valid callable records need not be rejected merely for representation, and factory exception class/text remains unspecified; do not invent assertions solely to distinguish contract-equivalent errors. New rail is authored and frozen before this source cleanup. Repeat independent review after final changes.

Additional error rail frozen at SHA256 416af3c9079fd8bf2c33fd11ac559082e771b0a8e93586c90a27a485080048a1. Ten new controls pass against current source and kill all eight independently verified missing-test mutations in an isolated source archive; no failing baseline implementation is claimed. Original rail remains byte-identical. Evidence: /tmp/t287-errors-mutations-sd8an1ai/summary.json. Freeze precedes field-validation cleanup.

P1 addendum settlement after checking existing frozen behavior: uniform bound read-fault refusal covers operational initial resolution AND mediated-read resolution/surface exceptions. Such failures return the same 404 text response and release no rendered HTML or raw diagnostic to the worker. Preserve the existing typed not_served result for an unavailable gesture lens: it only repeats the supplied lens, and nonexistent and out-of-scope lenses have the same result. This is an ordinary scoped answer, not an internal diagnostic. A legitimate empty entity remains successful. Existing root full/public behavior stays compatible. Author and freeze test/gateway/renderer-context-gesture-errors.test.ts before source repair; preserve both existing frozen rails. The earlier broader all-failure wording conflicted with the approved child-expansion rail and is superseded by this distinction. Independent P1 review confirmed no additional ambient information exposure from not_served.

Gesture error rail frozen at SHA256 f7f6d07d4e5f6fddb9e57e8dee5e77d9013f478809687bedd64a0180853ad804. Actual behavior-red before repair: two operational failure cases fail, while three real-worker normal/empty/not_served/root compatibility cases pass. Initial overbroad unavailable-lens expectation was revised before freeze, retaining its diagnostic log. Both earlier frozen rails remain byte-identical. Independent reproduced operational-diagnostic finding was recorded before repair.

Final independent P5 test audit confirmed a missing nested-identity mutation control; finding recorded before repair. Existing implementation freezes both outer context and copied binding correctly. Add test/gateway/renderer-context-identity.test.ts without changing earlier rails: attempt to retarget the issued binding itself to a second live container, then prove actual preparation/first-paint/mediated reads remain in the original scope while the independent sibling context works. No production Object.isFrozen-only assertion substitutes for observable scope. Measure baseline success and isolated removal of only nested Object.freeze causing new behavioral failure; preserve current source. This adds verification of the already-required immutable identity, not a new product contract.

Issued binding identity rail frozen at SHA256 467409df1f86bc89985103e875800d0d88a402ca8e6797c66c375f001f41522f. Actual source c859280 passes1/1. In an isolated archive, removing only the nested binding freeze causes this new behavioral test to return sibling first-paint/gesture data and fail, while all25 earlier context controls still pass. Allthree earlier frozen hashes unchanged. Source remains unchanged; this is additional verification of the existing immutable authority contract.
title: Require explicit root or bound context for renderer execution
